description: Optional, after sending a swap built by trnch_buy or trnch_sell on Elysium (chainId 99901): report its hash. Returns { ok, txHash, chainId, status: "pending", meaning }, an acknowledgement only: it does not send, cancel or change the transaction. Nothing is credited on the call. A scheduled pass (every 2 minutes) reads the transaction on Elysium: sent by the key's wallet, a swap Trnch built for it, and the Trnch fee paid to the Trnch fee recipient in that same transaction. Only then is its volume counted in the swap stats of Elysium; there are no points or rewards on this chain. A hash that does not prove all of this counts nothing. Calling it twice with the same hash changes nothing. 10 calls per minute per key; 20 hashes at most awaiting settlement per wallet (429). 409 if the wallet has no Trnch account (sign in once on the site). Requires an API key (created by wallet signature), sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

txHash.description: Hash of the Elysium transaction you sent.
